_: Which release of the prebuilt databases `gatekit data install` and `gatekit symbols install` fetch. The data is Baldur's Gate 3's own content, rearranged so it can be queried; it lives in its own repository so it can be withdrawn on its own, the same day Larian asks. A database and the tools that read it belong together, so this is pinned, not resolved at run time. Nothing has been published yet: with no tag, both commands refuse and point at the build commands. See docs/design/what-we-publish.md and publish/map/README.md.
